notes: Guo et al. 2021 subtyping procedure used 94 genes because 6 of the 100 original Chan-Seng-Yue 2020 signature genes were missing in the GEO processed matrix. Exact hierarchical clustering of the original paper is reproducible using the remaining 94 genes.

100% coverage achieved with gene symbol mapping of 4 outdated/alternative symbols in the GSE172356 matrix: CTSL2 mapped to CTSV, ANXA8L2 mapped to ANXA8, ATAD4 mapped to FLAD1, and LOC400573 mapped to TMEM238L. Guo et al. excluded LEMD1 in their validation, which reduces the active signature size to 49.
All 16 genes in the 8 Top Scoring Pairs (TSPs) are 100% present in the log2 analysis-ready matrix without symbol mapping. Extremely robust rank-based single-sample classifier.

Exploratory role. Standard 613-gene signature lacks a pre-fitted single-sample classifier or exact R/Python implementation code, making exact reproduction not possible in this project without substantial model training and adaptation.
